flags: PRESENCE / LONG-STAY (local, reviewer question; I read it as a possible drop): the only web presence is a 2016-era weebly site whose rate page is headed 'Camping Rates "2016"' and offers 'Per Month Camping: $175.00' and 'Extended Stay, Three Months or Longer ... $110.00 Per Month plus electric and $5.00 monthly meter charge' beside the $25 day rate. No city page, no booking channel beyond a contact form and phone, no rate dated 2024+, Google panel 'Community Park' with no reviews. Esri imagery shows ~45 trailers/RVs packed in two rows (stored count 20 from old note prose), consistent with long-stay occupancy, though the nightly share cannot be measured. Five tests: (1) nightly rate posted - only in 2016; (2) booking - phone/contact form, nothing current; (3) the page lists short stay first but prices monthly and extended stays cheaply; (4) nightly share unmeasurable; (5) no homes for sale. Mostly long-stay + iffy (stale rate, no reviews, no current site count) fits the reviewer's drop rule; a phone call to the office would settle whether nightly camping is still sold.
FEES: stored fees say 'Read 2026-10-15' but the page they came from is headed 2016; checked set to 2016. No 2024+ rate exists online.
PHONE: stored 217-589-4512 -> the campground site's contact page gives 'Office: 217-589-4463' (Roodhouse City Hall 217-589-4351). 217-589-4512 appears on no page I read.

WATERFRONT (stored lakeview; kept): the park lake is ~400 m long (imagery ~5-6 ha; the operator calls it a '5 acre stocked lake'). The west row of RVs on the east bank sits ~40-45 m from the water across a mowed grass slope with scattered trees - possibly lakefront for that row, but the site has no map or site numbers, so no upgrade; lakeview is supported for the west row. Lead only.
PIN: stored 39.46521,-90.36306 sits at the campground lane's north entrance; the rows centre ~39.4647,-90.3634 (~70 m). Kept.

HOOKUPS / FACILITIES (derived, left alone): the operator pages say nothing about hookups, showers, laundry or dump; the stored values rest on old note prose and directories (AllStays: ~20 full-hookup 50 A sites).
note: City of Roodhouse park and campground on the east bank of the park's stocked fishing lake, with a boat ramp, shelters and courts; the RV rows sit on a grass slope above the water. Tent sites too. --Claude
